question: On pinned HuggingFace revision (record hash) does Mind2Web official train/test_website/test_domain splits (137 websites/31 domains spec vs observed 73/3 divergence) show same-mechanism parameterized overlap via spec-compliant TF-IDF (max_features 5000, ngram 1-2, min_df 2, stop_words english) -> k-means k=min(50, unique_train_tasks/20) fitted train-only with 1000 website-label shuffles (seed 35725763380), 2000 bootstraps and k/2,2k sensitivity achieving overlap >=0.15 and excess vs shuffle >=0.10, and can Docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping full-DOM locatable_sample (n=21-82 per task, not truncated-first-20) be re-collected for 7 Magento tasks to measure canonical recipe ranking agreement at full element counts vs 80% threshold, closing the REJECTED model-extrapolation path (logistic vacuous L=0.5654, Hill h=20 at bound, 4 points 3 params)?
hypothesis: H1_CROSSSITE_OVERLAP: Mind2Web official splits share same-mechanism parameterized overlap under frozen fine-grained mechanism TF-IDF(max_features 5000, ngram 1-2, lowercase, stop english, min_df 2) -> k-means k=min(50, unique_train_tasks/20) n_init 10 random_state 35725763380 fitted train-only then predicted on test, with overlap = |M_test_website ∩ M_train|/|M_test_website| >=0.15 AND excess = overlap - shuffle_null_mean >=0.10 AND overlap > shuffle_p95 (1000 website-label shuffles preserving per-split task counts, seed 35725763380) AND param_prevalence >=0.15 AND PC2 recurrence >=1 cluster in >=10 tasks across >=3 websites AND bootstrap 95% CIs (2000 reps, same seed) exclude thresholds by >=0.05 margin, with k/2 and 2k sensitivity disclosed. H2_DOCKER_FULL_DOM: Docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 full-DOM locatable_sample collected at 1280x720 without 20-element cap yields per-task locatable_element counts 21-82 (listing 82, detail 32, cart 21 as parent census) and canonical recipe (per-iteration p=0.5 independent inclusion) ranking agreement F_full measured at those full counts either crosses 80% (F_full >=0.80) implying prior 0.5654 plateau was truncation artifact and ranking stabilizes with more elements, or remains <0.80 (F_full <=0.80 with CI upper <0.80) confirming logistic L=0.5654 vacuous plateau and Hill h=20 bound-hit were correct that agreement saturates below product threshold without new element types. Both hypotheses are shallow dataset reproduction tasks; positive on either axis unblocks a distinct downstream claim (H1 -> C-CROSSSITE website-holdout and Physics Gate0 SPA test; H2 -> C-PRODUCT-ECON direct measurement closing 6-model extrapolation REJECTED path).
falsifier: Gate0 INFRASTRUCTURE (precedence over scientific falsification): if Mind2Web HuggingFace osunlp/Mind2Web pinned revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain 4-way splits with 137 websites/31 domains (e.g., only single train 73/3/1009 as observed at HF 17ece8eb) after 3 retries with backoff, or HuggingFace unavailable, or Docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping image unavailable after 3 pulls / Playwright/CDP full-DOM enumeration fails after 3 retries, then that axis verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (status COMPLETE outcome NOT_APPLICABLE) not FALSIFIED, with durable error, revision hash or Docker digest, and divergence recorded; no synthetic 50/50 website split or truncated-first-20 extrapolation substituted as if official. Clause1 MIND2WEB: if spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means on official splits executed and (overlap <0.15 OR excess <0.10 OR overlap <= shuffle_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails OR bootstrap CI lower bound does not exceed threshold+0.05) then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for same-mechanism cross-website overlap; if spec-compliant mechanism/splits/null NOT executed (coarse 33-mechanism heuristic, single-split synthetic partition, label-shuffle null, unfitted k, test-leakage vectorizer) then INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID per audit required_fixes, not falsified. Clause2 DOCKER FULL-DOM: if full-DOM collection executed on 7 tasks (3 listing, 3 detail, 1 cart) with verified locatable counts 21-82 and (canonical ranking agreement F_full point estimate with bootstrap 95% CI upper <0.80, i.e., CI entirely below threshold) then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for crossing-80% at full counts (plateau confirmed below threshold); if F_full point estimate >=0.80 with CI lower >0.70 then SURVIVES for that axis (ranking stabilizes above threshold); if F_full CI straddles 0.80 (lower <0.80 < upper) then INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient precision at n=7). If locatable_sample still capped at 20 (MEASURE_JS locatableSample.length <20 present) or Docker enumeration yields <7 tasks or counts outside 21-82, then MEASUREMENT_INVALID not FALSIFIED. Truncated-first-20 diagnostic 0.5654 not used as falsifier for full-DOM. All thresholds frozen post-freeze; no post hoc relaxation.

Previous label-shuffle with random split_point and coarse 33-mechanism null (diagnostic 0.998) rejected. For Docker, random-subset null ranking agreement mean ~0.50; canonical must exceed null by >=0.20 to be discriminating. High null (e.g., 0.998 under coarse k=50) indicates coarse clustering not sharing; distinguished via k/2,2k.

baselines.description: Truncated-first-20 locatable_sample cap at 20 (EXP-INTEL-35330747199, EXP-INTEL-34782350557) yielding canonical ranking agreement 0.5654 at n=20 (4-point series 0.0/0.0/0.4996/0.5654). Retained as explicit baseline to test whether 80% threshold crossing is truncation artifact; direct full-DOM measurement (21-82 elements) must be compared to this baseline without extrapolation.
baselines.expected: Truncated baseline F=0.5654 (constant null for all n under logistic L). Full-DOM F_full compared via difference and CI overlap; if full-DOM significantly above truncated (non-overlapping 95% CIs) then truncation underestimated agreement.

baselines.description: Constant null F(n)=0.5654 for all n (logistic L=0.5654, Hill L=0.5657 at bound h=20, 4 points 3 params, R2=1.0 informationally vacuous per audit VF2-VF4 of EXP-INTEL-35551517470). Extrapolation path REJECTED after 6 failures (logistic k=10.75 step-function, Hill at bound, Richards fails). This is the null the Docker direct measurement must beat.
baselines.expected: Docker direct measurement must achieve F_full >=0.80 with CI lower >0.70 to reject constant null; otherwise plateau at 0.5654 stands.

decision_rule: Frozen ordered evaluation; Gate0 infrastructure precedence over scientific falsification. Gate0: if Mind2Web HF pinned revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain 4-way splits (e.g., single train 73/3 vs spec 137/31) after 3 retries OR HuggingFace unavailable after 3 retries, then Mind2Web axis = MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (outcome NOT_APPLICABLE), not FALSIFIED; if Docker image unavailable after 3 pulls OR Playwright full-DOM enumeration fails after 3 retries OR locatableSample cap still present (MEASURE_JS truncates at 20) OR <7 tasks enumerated, then Docker axis = MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED. Clause1 MIND2WEB_CROSS_WEBSITE: if spec-compliant TF-IDF(max_features 5000, ngram 1-2, min_df2, stop english)->k-means k=min(50,unique_train_tasks/20) fitted train-only on official splits executed and (overlap <0.15 OR excess <0.10 OR overlap <= shuffle_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails OR bootstrap CI lower does not exceed threshold+0.05 margin) then that axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for same-mechanism cross-website overlap; if spec-compliant pipeline NOT executed (coarse heuristic, synthetic partition, label-shuffle, unfitted k) then INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Clause2 DOCKER_FULL_DOM: if full-DOM enumeration on 7 tasks executed with verified counts 21-82 and no cap and (canonical ranking agreement F_full bootstrap 95% CI entirely below 80%, i.e., ci_upper <0.80) then that axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for 80% crossing (plateau below threshold confirmed); if F_full point estimate >=0.80 with ci_lower >0.70 then that axis = SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST for crossing (ranking stabilizes above threshold); if CI straddles 0.80 then INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient precision at n=7). Clause3 SURVIVES overall requires Gate0 pass AND (Clause1 SURVIVES AND Clause2 SURVIVES) with bootstrap CIs excluding thresholds by >=0.05 and k/2,2k sensitivity disclosed (Mind2Web excess remains >=0.10 for k/2 and 2k or disclosed why not) AND Docker F_full CI not straddling. Clause4 MIXED if one axis SURVIVES and other is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING or INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID with per-axis bounded ceiling (report which claim unblocked: Mind2Web PASS unblocks C-CROSSSITE/Physics Gate0; Docker PASS/FALSIFIED closes C-PRODUCT-ECON extrapolation debate). Clause5 duplication 0.9479 with exact_copy<0.2 is NOT a falsifier (parameterized reuse). Thresholds frozen; no post hoc relaxation; two-sided 95% bootstrap CIs and shuffle p95 test at alpha 0.05.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES both axes: C-CROSSSITE acquires MEASUREMENT-VALID website-holdout evidence (overlap >=0.15 excess >=0.10 beyond shuffle) unblocking Product/Physics to design Mind2Web website-holdout for cross-site parameterization (train-on-train/test-on-test_website with TF-IDF/k-means artifacts reused) AND C-PRODUCT-ECON closes 6-model REJECTED extrapolation debate with direct full-DOM empirical F_full vs 80% (either plateau below threshold confirmed, directing product to abandon ranking-stability assumption, or crossing above threshold, directing product to retain canonical recipe at scale). Either F_full outcome is decision-changing vs vacuous logistic. Artifacts (TF-IDF vocab/centroids hash, shuffle null distribution, full-DOM locatable samples 21-82, ranking agreement JSON) become reusable substrates for next Product launch. MIXED Mind2Web-only PASS: unblocks C-CROSSSITE website-holdout but C-PRODUCT-ECON remains bounded to direct-measurement ceiling; proceed with website-holdout only. MIXED Docker-only PASS/FALSIFIED: C-PRODUCT-ECON direct measurement replaces extrapolation and resolves ranking-stability question, but C-CROSSSITE remains census-only; product proceeds on within-store families only.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED Mind2Web axis (spec-compliant overlap <0.15 or excess <0.10 despite official splits): cross-website not demonstrably same-mechanism beyond website-label null at this granularity; C-CROSSSITE website-holdout not demonstrably same-mechanism on Mind2Web at k=min(50,unique/20) — future website-holdout limited to within-store families (36 families >=3) or custom construction/WebLINX/Go-Browse alternative corpus; do not claim cross-site generalization; Physics Gate0 production SPA test remains blocked pending alternative corpus. FALSIFIED Docker axis (F_full CI entirely <0.80): ranking agreement does not cross 80% even at full DOM 21-82 elements; logistic plateau L=0.5654 and Hill h=20 bound-hit are validated as saturating below threshold — canonical recipe does NOT achieve 80% ranking stability at Magento scale; product must not assume ranking stability, must change recipe (per-task weighted) or increase element types. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED either axis (HF revision without official splits, or Docker cap still present): no falsification; next action is infra repair (pin alternative HF revision/dump, remove locatableSample cap in measure_fullpage_yield.py:89, re-pull container) and re-run; do not treat as negative. In all negative/inclusive, ceiling remains WebArena census only (192/49 duplication 0.9479 exact 0.0781 param 0.8958 families 36/34/33) with AX 0.9, no LLM benefit demonstrated.

Mind2Web HF download ~1GB, TF-IDF 5000 feats + k-means k=min(50,unique/20) train-only <10 min, overlap + 1000 website-label shuffles seed 35725763380 ~15 min, bootstrap 2000 reps ~5 min, k/2,2k sensitivity ~10 min. Docker full-DOM: image pull am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 (~1GB) + Playwright install (~300MB) + 7 full-DOM enumerations at 1280x720 with cap-removed JS (~30 min) + ranking agreement and random-role null 1000 perms + bootstrap 2000 reps ~10 min. Total <3h wall-clock, <5GB /tmp, stdlib+datasets+scikit-learn+playwright. No model calls; reuse WebArena census from parent (no re-extraction of 20 AX trees).
expected_information_gain: HIGH (portfolio-level blocking for two claims): Mind2Web spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means train-only with website-label shuffle + 2000 bootstraps + k/2,2k sensitivity is the ONLY remaining falsifier for C-CROSSSITE same-mechanism cross-website overlap after 5 MEASUREMENT_INVALID loops using coarse 33-mechanism heuristic and synthetic 60/40 split; clean positive (overlap >=0.15 excess >=0.10) unlocks highest-leverage website-holdout product promise and Physics Gate0 SPA test, while clean negative (spec-compliant <thresholds) definitively closes Mind2Web at this granularity and redirects to WebLINX/Go-Browse. Docker full-DOM direct measurement (21-82 elements, not truncated 20) is the ONLY remaining path to settle C-PRODUCT-ECON ranking agreement vs 80% after REJECTED verdict on 6 model extrapolations (logistic R2=1.0 vacuous step-function k=10.75 L=0.5654, Hill h=20 at bound, Richards fails, linear extrapolations >1.0 impossible); model-based path definitively closed per audit, so direct empirical F_full is information-theoretically decisive — either it crosses 80% (truncation artifact) or it does not (plateau confirmed). Bundling both shallow dataset reproduction tasks in one Intel unit efficiently unblocks C-CROSSSITE and C-PRODUCT-ECON without duplicating product LLM holdout work. Decision-changing for both claims; no synthetic divergence or freshness tuning can match this leverage.
